'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
***[[Twelve-Day War]]
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches a bombing campaign against [[Iran]] targeting [[nuclear facilities in Iran|nuclear facilities]] with the main goal of the operation being to destroy [[nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear program]]. A special [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[Israel]] by [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defence Minister]] [[Israel Katz]] and Israeli [[airspace]] is closed to all flights. Iranian state television reports that 60 people were killed in the attacks, while Israel claims only three people died and dozens got injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t (BBC News)] 
****Israel also launches [[Targeted killing|targeted assassination]] strikes against senior [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]] officials, [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian military]] leadership and senior nuclear scientists. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-likely-killed-iranian-chief-staff-top-nuclear-scientists-official-2025-06-13/ (Reuters)]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] confirms it has targeted [[nuclear facilities in Iran]] with the main goal of the operation being to destroy [[nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear program]]. [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] confirms Israeli warplanes have targeted Iran's main [[Natanz Nuclear Facility]]. It is later confirmed that the underground [[nuclear reactor]] at Natanz has been destroyed by a [[bunker buster]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-857603 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t (BBC News)]
****Iranian [[state media]] reports that all flights to and from [[Imam Khomeini International Airport]] have been suspended until further notice and that several residential buildings in Tehran have collapsed due to [[missile]] strikes. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-june-12-2025/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****Israeli [[Decapitation (military strategy)|decapitation strikes]] kill commander-in-chief of the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] [[Hossein Salami]], senior nuclear scientist and former head of the [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran]] [[Fereydoon Abbasi]], and chief of the [[General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran]] [[Mohammad Bagheri (general)|Mohammad Bagheri]] and [[Quds Force]] commander [[Esmail Qaani]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/report-head-of-irans-elite-quds-force-killed-in-israeli-strike/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t (BBC News)] 
****Exiled crown prince [[Reza Pahlavi, Crown Prince of Iran|Reza Pahlavi]], the son of Iran's last [[Mohammad Reza Pahlavi|Shah]], writes in [[Persian language|Farsi]] calling for the Iranian military to abandon the Islamic Republic and accuses [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei|Ayatollah Ali Khamenei]] of forcing Iranians into the war. He also refers to the war as "Khamenei's war and the Islamic Republic's war". [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-857604 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[June 2025 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
****Iran launches over 100 [[Shahed drones]] and [[Iran's ballistic missiles program|ballistic missiles]] towards Israel in retaliation for the strikes. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/over-100-drones-launched-by-iran-at-israel-in-last-few-hours-idf-working-to-shoot-them-down/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-it-strikes-iran-amid-nuclear-tensions-2025-06-13/ (Reuters)]
****At least three people are killed and 172 others injured in Israel after Iran's retaliatory strikes. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/2025-06-12/live-updates-857426 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Air India Flight 171]]
**The death toll from the crash of an [[Air India]] [[Boeing 787 Dreamliner]] shortly after takeoff from [[Ahmedabad Airport]] in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]], yesterday rises to 279 as a police source says 38 ground fatalities are confirmed. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/280474/india-plane-crash-death-toll-rises-to-279 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
* Heavy flooding hits [[San Antonio]], [[Texas]]; at least 11 people are killed, and the [[San Antonio River]] rises from 3 feet to 25 feet in about 2 hours. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/06/12/weather/san-antonio-flooding-texas-climate (CNN)]
*Five people are killed, including two children, and 16 others are injured, including two critically, in a [[traffic collision]] when an [[Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation]] bus loses control and crashes into the back of a truck at Gottipura Gate in [[Hoskote]], [[Karnataka]], India. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bengaluru/drowsy-driver-rams-bus-with-30-onboard-into-truck-in-hoskote-5-killed-16-injured/articleshow/121837207.cms (''India Today'')] [https://www.deshsewak.org/english/news/201906 (Deshsewak)]
*Four people are killed and 34 others are injured, including 11 seriously, when a bus carrying [[Ukrainians]] crashes on the [[A81 autoroute]] in [[Sarthe]], [[France]]. [https://www.midilibre.fr/2025/06/13/dramatique-accident-de-car-quatre-morts-dans-un-bus-qui-transportait-des-ados-et-adultes-ukrainiens-12759891.php (''Midi Libre'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
**[[June 2025 Los Angeles protests]]
***[[U.S.]] [[United States federal judge|district judge]] [[Charles Breyer]] issues a temporary restraining order directing [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|President Donald Trump]] to return control of the [[California National Guard|National Guard]] to [[California]], saying he violated the [[Tenth Amendment to the United States Constitution|Tenth Amendment]] and exceeded his statutory authority. Later, the [[United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit|9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals]] temporarily blocks the order. [https://apnews.com/article/california-immigration-national-guard-newsom-trump-lawsuit-aedf8cdd95ee899c9559d5e54a2e4833 (AP)] [https://thehill.com/regulation/court-battles/5348353-appeals-court-temporarily-lifts-judges-block-on-trumps-national-guard-deployment/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[Kenya Finance Bill protests]]
**[[Kenya]]n [[Kenya Police|police]] [[constable]] James Mukhwana is arrested over the death of [[blog]]ger [[Death of Albert Ojwang|Albert Ojwang]], which prompted protests and clashes with police this week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/13/kenya-police-officer-arrested-over-bloggers-death-in-custody (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq54vl9wl77o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[North Korea]]n [[destroyer]] ''[[North Korean destroyer Kang Kon|Kang Kon]]'' is successfully launched, having partially sunk during its first launch attempt two weeks prior. [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|Supreme Leader]] [[Kim Jong Un]] announces plans for two more 5,000-tonne destroyers to be built next year. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/13/n-koreas-kim-eyes-more-warships-as-damaged-destroyer (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1mgd0252kpo (BBC News)]
*In [[South Korea]], five-term [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] lawmaker [[Kim Byung-kee]] is elected as floor leader of the [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 2015)|Democratic Party]], replacing acting party leader [[Park Chan-dae (politician)|Park Chan-dae]]. [https://m.koreaherald.com/article/10508942 (''The Korea Herald'')]
